title: useful Sword
description: Compilation of the most utilised and effective swords for Minecrafters, 11 swords altogether, compatible with Minecraft version 1.21.8. Based on and dedicated to the classic Swords mod created by (Furti_Two). Updated for newer versions
body:
Remastered Edition of the legendary Useless Sword mod for contemporary Minecraft. Introducing new mechanics and advanced material tiers.

✨ Major Highlights:
End Crystal Sword: A dangerous tool that triggers an explosion of crystals and gives the wielder Absorption III and Levitation resistance upon contact.

Netherite Coal: An extremely hot material obtained by smelting refined Netherite. Serves as the base component for Tier-6 gear.

Strengthened Staves: Advanced crafting elements derived from hardened basalt and carbon fibers for constructing robust weapons.
